function: Excluded as system: over-the-air personalized federated learning over a scalar fading link, one gain per client (p. 5, Eq. 11), with no antenna array or RIS.
notes: Excluded, code system. Steps 1 to 5 pass: the learned element is the personalized model trained with analog over-the-air aggregation and random-k compression (p. 4-5), which is area 7. The link is a single-antenna scalar channel: p. 5 models the received waveform as a sum over clients of a scalar fading gain times the transmitted waveform plus noise, with "we assume the channel fading is i.i.d. across clients", and p. 7 uses "we employ Rayleigh fading to model the channel gain" plus symmetric alpha-stable noise. The paper never states an antenna count, and no array, beamforming or RIS appears in its system model (Section III, p. 3-5); RIS is cited only as related work on p. 3. The single-antenna reading rests on the scalar model, so the reviewer may want to confirm it. Data items and criteria are left empty as instructed.
